literal: Even if they possess boundlessly established support, they will not escape, if those of excellently established greatness become angry.
translation: Even if they possess boundless and powerful support, they will not escape ruin if those of eminent and established greatness become angry.
modern: மிகவும் சிறந்த பாதுகாப்பைப் பெற்றிருந்தாலும், சிறந்த பெருமைகளை உடைய பெரியவர்கள் கோபமடைந்தால், அவர்களிடமிருந்து தப்பிப் பிழைக்க முடியாது.
explanation: This couplet warns against provoking the wrath of highly realized, great individuals. Even if a person has immense, seemingly invincible worldly support (சார்பு) from kings, armies, or wealth, it will not save them from ruin. If those who possess eminent and established greatness (சீரார்) are provoked to anger (செறின்), the offender cannot escape (உய்யார்) destruction. The contrast between worldly protection and the spiritual power of the great shows that moral and spiritual force always triumphs over material strength.
